# Internal Home Depot Demo Prep
Date: 2026-11-03 | Duration: 11m

## Summary
The discussion covered the need for additional sales capacity because of high deal volume, although no hiring decision or start date was confirmed after a preferred candidate joined SpaceX. Revenue was described as approximately $13–14 million, up from roughly $6 million when Logan Bates started, with $15 million identified as an annual target. Home Depot requires a largely generic, remote platform demonstration focused on pain points, technical workflows, lifecycle requirements, and platform alignment; Logan will review customer requirements forwarded by Scott Keller. Scott identified seven enterprise opportunities—Grubhub, SPF, OLX Group, Expedia, Zalando, Washington Post, and Natera—with a goal of closing them before Christmas for a cleaner January start. In a low-engagement Lockheed Martin demo, Scott used a $125,000 platform fee and a $135,000 quote for five users. Logan and Scott also discussed Pro versus enterprise packaging, account management, expansion, and the need for greater leadership transparency.

## Keywords
Home Depot demo, Enterprise sales, GrowthBook platform, Adobe Target, Sales pipeline, Pro versus Enterprise

## Action Items
**Logan Bates**
Review Home Depot requirements email (02:59)
Prepare Home Depot platform demo (10:27)

**Scott Keller**
Conduct Home Depot demo remotely (10:34)
